provenance: Fresh questions authored by the independent reviewer after correction freeze, from the frozen original MIT synthetic corpus. No queries or evaluation were executed on these cases before this manifest.
split_method: All20 new fixed IDs are first-run evaluation only; no tuning or training on them. Historical original/evolved questions remain exposed development data.
metric_semantics: Frozen evaluator labeled_support accepts one matching source passage; for multi-document questions this is partial source support, not completeness. Critical_fact requires all labeled phrases and is the completeness check.

The repository field recall_at_3 measures any relevant-document hit, not fraction recall for multi-document cases. The runner will additionally report multi-document all-required-documents-at3 coverage.
Unsupported adversarial requests ask for information absent from the corpus; refusal means answerable=false and no citations.
No required accuracy floor is selected from evaluation results. The first-run evidence can subsequently become an exposed fixed regression reference, never an unseen test for further tuning.
limitations: 20 purposively selected authored cases, not a representative random sample or statistical generalization.
Reviewer has inspected frozen implementation, historical results and corpus; independence is from implementation authorship and fresh outcome observations, not a blinded evaluation.
Single-line answerer is expected to have a multi-document limitation; cases are retained to measure it.
